editorial:
Ever wondered how a lifelong friendship can turn into a nightmare? You get to see that happen here with So-yool and Yeon-hee. They start off as two girls with a big dream to make it as singers in Seoul. Everything seems great until a guy named Yoon-woo enters the picture. He is a talented songwriter and So-yool's first love, but he falls for Yeon-hee's voice instead. It is a classic setup, but it feels personal because you can really feel So-yool's heart break. The movie quickly shifts from a sweet story about music to a tense drama about jealousy and hate.

The acting is what really sells the story, especially as you watch So-yool go from a supportive friend to someone who will do anything to win. While the plot moves a bit slowly in the middle, the shocking twists at the end make it worth the wait. If you love stories about secret rivals, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything crashes down when So-yool's lies are finally exposed. Her plan to ruin Yeon-hee and Yoon-woo fails, leaving her alone and broken. The movie ends with a sad realization that her jealousy destroyed the only people who actually cared about her. There is no happy ending here; instead, you see the heavy price of betrayal. It wraps up by showing that you cannot build your own success on the ruins of someone else's life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about friendship, betrayal, and musical dreams.
